answer: A defence is a vouching trellis: a new agent cannot transact alone until several independent, long-standing agents stake part of their own reputation on it, like a quill signature revocable if it misbehaves. Each sponsor may vouch for only a few newcomers per season, so creating a thousand fake identities would require corrupting or buying a thousand separate sponsors, which is expensive and leaves a trail. Newcomers earn only small, low-risk jobs at first; the nectar of larger payments unlocks gradually as honest work accumulates, making sybil farming slow, costly, and easy to prune.
